page_title: BBC Learning English - English at Work / The warehouse
title: The warehouse
description:
Anna's checking up on some orders today. As a result of some embarrassing mistakes in deliveries, Tip Top Trading's big boss in America has ordered a re-check of every order this month. Let's hear how she checks on things in the warehouse.
This episode explores language for checking information.
phrases: I just want to make sure that...
One thing I wasn't sure of was...

listening_challenge.question: What kind of fruit was sent out to Mr Berry of Bluetree Enterprise?

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Welcome back! This is what's happening today: as a result of some embarrassing mistakes in deliveries, Tip Top Trading's big boss in America has ordered a re-check of every order this month. So, Paul is talking to key customers to see if they've got what they needed:

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: I just want to check you're happy with the grapes?

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Tom, whom we all know was responsible for the disaster, is phoning his clients to make sure he has the correct information about what they want:

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Ya, yah, I just want to make absolutely sure we get the order right for you and have the correct number of fruit...

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Denise is, well, talking on the phone to a friend.

transcript.speaker: Denise
transcript.text: Brown shoes don't look right on him! He's not a brown shoe sort of person...

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Anna has to go down to the warehouse, where the products are prepared for delivery.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I have to speak to Mr Ingle. Apparently he's not very friendly! He might not like me asking lots of questions!

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text:
Well, be polite, and start your sentences with things like: 
I just want to make sure that... 
Could you possibly clarify... 
I just want to check... 
Just to be absolutely clear... 
One thing I wasn't sure of was...
Good luck!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Mr Ingle, I don't think we've met yet, I'm Anna.

transcript.speaker: Ingle
transcript.text: Hello. Oi! What are you doing with those boxes? I told you to put them in storage. Anna, is it?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Yes, sorry to bother you, I just want to check something. We've had a few problems with orders….

transcript.speaker: Ingle
transcript.text: Well, that's not my fault. I do exactly what I'm asked to do. (To workers) No, not there, in storage!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Oh, well, I just want to make sure that….

transcript.speaker: Ingle
transcript.text: Thirty years I've been doing this job, and I've never made a mistake.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Of course, but because we've had problems, we need to make absolutely sure that all deliveries are correct.

transcript.speaker: Ingle
transcript.text: Humph.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Could you possibly clarify what went out in today's delivery to Mr Berry of, er, Bluetree Enterprises?

transcript.speaker: Ingle
transcript.text: 500 redcurrants.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Right. That's fine.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Well done Anna, this is going very well. Remember that other phrase – "I just want to check…"

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: OK. Now, I just want to check what was sent to Cocoline Limited – it should have been fifteen mangos...

transcript.speaker: Ingle
transcript.text: Yeah. That's right.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Great, and just to be absolutely clear, you sent the soft mangos, not the plastic ones?

transcript.speaker: Ingle
transcript.text: Yes, just like I was told to.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Good. One thing I wasn't sure of was whether we had enough yellow bananas in stock – I know there are some purple ones, but...

transcript.speaker: Ingle
transcript.text: Yeah well, we do need more yellow bananas.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Okay, I'll just write that down. Thank you Mr Ingle. By the way, I like your overalls!

transcript.speaker: Ingle
transcript.text: Oh thanks.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Well he was a bit unfriendly, but Anna got what she needed. Here are the phrases she used:
Well, everything in the warehouse seems to be okay. Back in the office, Tom is having less luck.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: (on the phone) Really? Here it says 5,000 not five... oh...

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: It's going to be a long day for him! Until next time. Bye!
